name: the grants world -- sentence-level cases for Haro v0.32 (DEFINE PATTERN, BLOCKS.md 4.3; Central's item 3, the value join)
comment: Written BEFORE any court code reads a PATTERN. Each case runs the court forged from grants_v32.haro on haro AND on its checked build; the two must print the same bytes. The sentences are in grants/: clean, ungranted, primary_ungranted, no_zone, bad_channel, many, union, absent, empty, two. A refusal is at the line of the clause it is about (WANTS line 8, PRIMARY line 9, VIA line 9, and line 4 in the zoneless sentence), not at the declaration's.

cases.name: the clean sentence: one zone, one use, every right asked for is granted
the meta-court reads the world: four patterns, a menu, a form, two declarations
the value join on a list: a right no zone grants is refused at its WANTS clause, in the declared words
contains: grants (line 8): USE report wants a right no ZONE grants

cases.name: the envelope: the pattern's code and the cite it declares
the value join on one value, a rule another pattern uses by name: the primary right is refused at its PRIMARY clause (line 9)
contains: grants (line 9): USE report needs a right most, and no ZONE grants it

cases.name: a set with no member: no zone, so the right asked for is granted by no one
contains: grants (line 4): USE report wants a right no ZONE grants

cases.name: a list judged against a MENU's words: a channel the menu lacks is refused at its VIA clause (line 9)
contains: grants (line 9): USE report goes through something that is no channel

cases.name: CITES none: the envelope carries the code and no cite
SEVERITY warning: the sentence stands and the pattern speaks after the verdict, with its code and line
contains: warning MANY_RIGHTS: USE report asks for more than three rights (line 8)

cases.name: a warning is a warning in the envelope too
a set is the UNION of every zone's rights: two zones grant one right each, and a use may ask for both
a seat the sentence does not write is not judged
an empty list asks for nothing, and every right it asks for is granted
two patterns refuse at once: diagnose carries both findings, each at its own line
